intro.title: How Do Marriott Bonvoy Points Work on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises?
paragraphs: If you already collect Marriott Bonvoy points, The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection gives you another way to use the program beyond traditional hotel stays.

Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection participates in Marriott Bonvoy, allowing eligible members to earn Marriott Bonvoy points on qualifying cruise fares, earn Elite Night Credits for nights aboard the yacht, earn on qualifying Marriott hotel packages booked through the yacht collection, and redeem points toward eligible cruise fare savings.
But the program does not work exactly like booking a Marriott hotel with points.

The redemption structure is different, the number of points required is substantially higher than a typical hotel redemption, and Marriott Bonvoy points cannot simply be used as a standard award booking for a Ritz-Carlton Yacht suite.
This guide explains exactly how the program works, how much you can earn, how redemptions work, what Elite members receive onboard, and what to know before using your points.

quickAnswer.title: Can You Use Marriott Bonvoy Points on Ritz-Carlton Yachts?
quickAnswer.introText: Marriott Bonvoy members can both earn and redeem points with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection. Members can earn:
earningBullets: 5 Marriott Bonvoy points per $1 on qualifying cruise fare paid
5 points per $1 on qualifying Marriott hotel package rates booked through Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection
1 Elite Night Credit for each qualifying night aboard the yacht
Additional points when using an eligible Marriott Bonvoy co-branded credit card, subject to the card's terms
quickAnswer.redemptionIntro: For redemptions, members can currently redeem:
redemptionBullets: Additional increments can be used under the applicable redemption terms
Full points redemption of cruise fare may be available on eligible bookings
Points do not cover taxes, fees and port expenses.
distinctionParagraphs: You are not booking a Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruise as a conventional Marriott Bonvoy award night.
Instead, Marriott Bonvoy points are applied as a savings amount against eligible cruise fare.

howManyPointsEarn.headlineRate: 5 Marriott Bonvoy Points per $1 of Qualifying Cruise Fare
tableFootnotes: These are base points calculated from qualifying cash paid toward the cruise fare.
The official terms specify five base points per U.S. dollar, or the applicable currency equivalent, on qualifying cruise fare paid by the member.

The terms describe Cruise Fare as including items such as:

notEarnSection.treatmentText: The exact treatment depends on whether an item forms part of the qualifying Cruise Fare or is separately charged.

simpleRule.title: The Simple Rule
paragraphs: Don't assume that every dollar you spend onboard earns Marriott points.
The important number is your qualifying Cruise Fare, not your total onboard spending.

hotelPackagesSection.title: Can You Earn Marriott Bonvoy Points on a Ritz-Carlton Yacht Hotel Package?
paragraphs: If you book a qualifying Marriott Bonvoy participating hotel package through The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection, you can also earn Marriott Bonvoy points.
The current terms specify 5 points per $1 on the qualifying hotel package rate paid by the member.
The qualifying hotel package rate includes:
hotelPackagesSection.benefitNote: This can be particularly useful when combining a pre-cruise hotel stay with your yacht vacation.

example.title: Example: Cruise + Marriott Hotel Package
example.hotelPoints: Hotel package points: $1,500 × 5 = 7,500 Marriott Bonvoy points
example.note: This example excludes any additional credit-card earnings and assumes the full amounts qualify under the applicable terms.

eliteNightCreditsSection.title: Do You Earn Elite Night Credits on Ritz-Carlton Yachts?
paragraphs: This is one of the most significant benefits for Marriott Bonvoy members who are pursuing Elite status.
Members can earn:
1 Elite Night Credit for each qualifying night aboard the yacht.

The terms specify that the member must personally pay for and stay in the qualifying suite. Qualifying hotel packages can also generate Elite Night Credits for the hotel nights personally paid for and used by the member.
eliteNightCreditsSection.calculationTitle: How Many Elite Night Credits Can You Earn?
eliteNightCreditsSection.calculationOutro: The actual number depends on the qualifying number of nights in your voyage.

eliteBonusPointsSection.title: Do Marriott Bonvoy Elite Members Get Bonus Points on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises?
paragraphs: The standard RCYC terms specify 5 base points per qualifying dollar regardless of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status.
In other words, don't automatically calculate the cruise using the hotel-style Marriott Elite bonus structure.
Instead, separate the benefits into:
Earning: 5 base points per qualifying $1
Elite status: Additional onboard benefits depending on your Marriott Bonvoy tier.
The RCYC-specific program has its own onboard Elite benefits structure.

eliteBenefitsSection.title: What Marriott Bonvoy Elite Benefits Do You Get on Ritz-Carlton Yachts?
eliteBenefitsSection.intro: Marriott Bonvoy Elite members receive additional onboard benefits. The current RCYC terms list benefits that vary by Elite tier, including:
eliteBenefitsSection.outro: Benefits are subject to the current RCYC terms and eligibility requirements.

statusTransfer.title: Does Marriott Bonvoy Status Transfer to the Yacht?
paragraphs: Yes, but the benefits are RCYC-specific.
This is an important distinction.
Having Marriott Bonvoy Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador Elite status does not mean that every hotel benefit automatically carries over to the yacht.
The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection has its own list of Elite onboard benefits.

The current terms specifically state that certain Marriott Bonvoy benefits available at participating properties are not available at RCYC, including the Elite Benefits Guarantee and Ultimate Reservation Guarantee.
So the best way to think about it is:
Your Marriott Bonvoy status is recognized, but the yacht applies its own onboard Elite benefits.

redeemPointsSection.title: Can You Redeem Marriott Bonvoy Points for a Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruise?
paragraphs: This is where the program becomes particularly interesting.
Marriott Bonvoy members can redeem points toward eligible Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruise fare savings.
The current redemption structure begins at:
180,000 Points → $1,000 Cruise Fare Savings
After the initial redemption:
90,000 Points → $500 Cruise Fare Savings
The terms also state that full points redemption of the Cruise Fare may be available for eligible voyages.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Pay for an Entire Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruise With Points?
paragraphs: The current Marriott Bonvoy terms state that full Points redemption of the Cruise Fare may be available.
However, redemption availability applies to the specific cruise, and points do not cover taxes, fees and port expenses.
Therefore, travelers should not assume that every Ritz-Carlton Yacht voyage can automatically be booked entirely with points.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Use Points for Taxes and Port Fees?
paragraphs: Marriott Bonvoy points redeemed through the RCYC program do not cover taxes, fees and port expenses.
This is an important consideration when calculating your actual out-of-pocket cost.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Use Marriott Bonvoy Points for the Hotel Portion?
paragraphs: This is another important difference.
You can earn Marriott Bonvoy points on qualifying Marriott hotel packages booked through The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection.
However, you cannot redeem Marriott Bonvoy points for those hotel packages through RCYC.
If you want to use Marriott Bonvoy points for a Marriott hotel stay, the RCYC terms direct members to book the hotel through Marriott.com or the Marriott Bonvoy app.

summaryBox.title: In Simple Terms
items: Redeem points toward eligible cruise fare: Yes
Redeem points for RCYC hotel package: No
Book a separate Marriott hotel with points: Yes, subject to Marriott's normal award availability and rules

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Earn Points on Multiple Suites?
paragraphs: A Marriott Bonvoy member can earn points on up to three suites at double occupancy, provided the member:
• Pays for the qualifying cruise fare
• Is booked in one of the suites
• Stays in one of the suites
This can be particularly relevant for families or multigenerational groups traveling together.

detailedPolicies.title: Can Two Marriott Bonvoy Members Earn Points From the Same Suite?
paragraphs: It depends on who actually paid the qualifying portion.
The current terms state that points can only be earned by the guest who makes the payment toward the qualifying cruise fare or hotel package.
Simply having two Marriott Bonvoy members in the same suite does not automatically mean both members receive points for the same expenditure.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Earn Marriott Points With a Travel Advisor?
paragraphs: You can book a Ritz-Carlton Yacht through a travel professional and still participate in Marriott Bonvoy.
The important requirement is making sure your Marriott Bonvoy membership number is associated with the booking within the required timeframe.
The current RCYC FAQ states that members should provide their Marriott Bonvoy number at least 30 days before sailing to ensure eligibility for points.
This is particularly relevant if you book through a luxury travel advisor.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Add Your Marriott Bonvoy Number After Booking?
paragraphs: If you have already booked your Ritz-Carlton Yacht voyage but were not yet a Marriott Bonvoy member, the official FAQ states that you can still become eligible to earn points on the existing booking if you provide your Marriott Bonvoy number at least 30 days before sailing.

bestPractice.title: Best Practice
bestPractice.text: Do not wait until embarkation. Add your Marriott Bonvoy number as early as possible after booking.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Redeem Points After Booking?
detailedPolicies.badge: Yes, But There Is a Deadline
paragraphs: The current terms state that members can apply Marriott Bonvoy points toward eligible cruise fare up until 121 days before the scheduled voyage departure, when final payment is due.
This means: Booking the cruise does not necessarily mean your points must be applied immediately. However, you should plan your redemption before the applicable deadline.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Redeem Points Online?
paragraphs: Not Through the Standard Online Reservation Flow.
The current RCYC FAQ states that Marriott Bonvoy points cannot currently be redeemed directly through the standard online reservation experience.
If you want to apply points toward the voyage fare, a Personal Travel Professional can assist with the redemption and apply it to the reservation.
This is one reason working with a knowledgeable travel advisor can simplify the process.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Use Points for Someone Else's Cruise?
paragraphs: Marriott Bonvoy points can be used toward the cruise fare of another guest traveling on the same voyage.
If the Marriott Bonvoy member is not traveling on that voyage, the points must first be transferred to the other guest's Marriott Bonvoy account under the applicable Marriott Bonvoy transfer rules.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Buy Marriott Bonvoy Points for a Ritz-Carlton Yacht Redemption?
paragraphs: The official RCYC FAQ states that members may purchase additional Marriott Bonvoy points if they do not have enough points for the desired redemption.
The purchase remains subject to Marriott Bonvoy's applicable terms and conditions.

detailedPolicies.title: What Happens to Points if You Cancel?
paragraphs: The treatment of redeemed points follows the applicable Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection cancellation terms.

The current RCYC Marriott Bonvoy terms state that if a booking is cancelled and points were applied toward the Cruise Fare, the points are refunded before the cash balance, subject to the standard cancellation policy.
Also remember: No Points or Elite Night Credit are issued for cancelled voyages.

detailedPolicies.title: When Do Marriott Bonvoy Points Post?
paragraphs: For qualifying RCYC cruise bookings, the current terms state that points and Elite Night Credits are automatically added to the member's account within 14 days following completion of the voyage, provided the Marriott Bonvoy membership information was properly associated with the booking.

ifPointsDoNotAppear.title: If Your Points Do Not Appear
ifPointsDoNotAppear.text: If more than 14 days have passed after the cruise, contact The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection and provide the relevant booking and Marriott Bonvoy information.

detailedPolicies.title: Can You Earn Extra Marriott Points With a Marriott Bonvoy Credit Card?
paragraphs: The RCYC terms state that members using an eligible Marriott Bonvoy co-branded credit card for qualifying purchases through Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection can earn additional points according to their card's terms.
This means your total points can potentially consist of:
Layer 1: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection base earning
Layer 2: Eligible Marriott Bonvoy credit-card earning
The exact credit-card earning rate depends on the specific card and its current terms.
Do not assume every Marriott Bonvoy card provides the same additional earning rate.

ambassadorSection.title: What About Marriott Bonvoy Ambassador Members?
paragraphs: Ambassador Elite members can receive RCYC-specific benefits when sailing, subject to the applicable terms.
The current RCYC terms identify Ambassador Elite as the highest listed Marriott Bonvoy Elite tier and include additional yacht benefits such as:
• Elite reception
• In-suite welcome gift
• First-evening laundry pressing
• Priority boarding and departure
• Early S.E.A. reservation access
• Complimentary laundry throughout the cruise
The exact benefit eligibility is governed by the current RCYC Marriott Bonvoy terms.

eliteStatusCredit.title: Do Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises Count Toward Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status?
paragraphs: This is an important advantage for Marriott Bonvoy members who are working toward Elite status.
Qualifying yacht nights count toward Elite Night Credit.
For example:
• 7-night cruise = 7 Elite Night Credits
• 10-night cruise = 10 Elite Night Credits
• 14-night cruise = 14 Elite Night Credits
The member must meet the applicable requirements for the suite and nights to qualify.

qualifyingSpend.title: Do Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises Count Toward Ambassador Qualifying Spend?
paragraphs: The current RCYC terms state that the cash portion paid toward qualifying Cruise Fare and qualifying hotel package rates counts toward the qualified annual spend requirement for Marriott Bonvoy Ambassador Elite status.
This can make an expensive yacht vacation particularly relevant for travelers already pursuing Marriott Bonvoy Ambassador status.

chartersSection.title: What About Full-Yacht Charters?
paragraphs: The rules are different for certain charter and incentive bookings.

The standard terms state that members cannot earn points or benefits on full-yacht buyouts/charters and incentive groups booked through the RCYC Meetings and Incentive department, subject to the specific qualifying group and charter provisions in the terms.
Therefore, don't assume that a yacht charter receives the same Marriott Bonvoy treatment as a standard individual cruise booking.

strategySection.title: A Marriott Bonvoy Strategy for Ritz-Carlton Yacht Travelers
strategySection.intro: If you are planning a Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruise and already participate in Marriott Bonvoy, consider this sequence:

steps.description: Determine how many points you currently have.
Separate the qualifying Cruise Fare from taxes, fees, excursions and other nonqualifying expenses.
Multiply qualifying Cruise Fare by: 5 points per $1
Multiply qualifying yacht nights by: 1 Elite Night Credit per night
Determine which RCYC-specific onboard benefits apply to your status.
Compare the standard redemption value: 180,000 points = $1,000 against your alternative Marriott Bonvoy redemption opportunities.
Make sure your Marriott Bonvoy number is attached to the reservation within the required timeframe.

steps.step: Step 8 — Work With Your Travel Advisor
steps.description: If redeeming points, ask your Personal Travel Professional to confirm the redemption and applicable deadline.

faqs.question: 1. Can I use Marriott Bonvoy points on Ritz-Carlton Yacht Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Marriott Bonvoy members can redeem points toward eligible Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruise fare savings.

faqs.question: 2. How many Marriott Bonvoy points do I earn on a Ritz-Carlton Yacht?
faqs.answer: Members earn five Marriott Bonvoy base points for each U.S. dollar of qualifying cruise fare paid.

faqs.question: 3. How many Marriott points do I need for a Ritz-Carlton Yacht?
faqs.answer: The standard initial redemption is 180,000 Marriott Bonvoy points for $1,000 in cruise fare savings, followed by 90,000-point increments for $500 savings.

faqs.question: 4. How much is 180,000 Marriott Bonvoy points worth on a Ritz-Carlton Yacht?
faqs.answer: Under the standard RCYC redemption rate, 180,000 points provide $1,000 in cruise fare savings, equivalent to approximately 0.56 cents per point.

faqs.question: 5. Can I pay for a Ritz-Carlton Yacht entirely with Marriott points?
faqs.answer: Full points redemption of Cruise Fare may be available on eligible bookings, but availability is not guaranteed and points do not cover taxes, fees and port expenses.

faqs.question: 6. Do Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruises earn Marriott Elite Night Credits?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible members earn one Elite Night Credit for each qualifying night aboard the yacht.

faqs.question: 7. Do Marriott Bonvoy Elite members get benefits on Ritz-Carlton Yachts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Elite members receive RCYC-specific onboard benefits that vary by Marriott Bonvoy tier.

faqs.question: 8. Do Marriott Bonvoy Platinum members get hotel-style benefits onboard?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. RCYC provides its own set of onboard Elite benefits, and certain standard Marriott property guarantees do not apply to RCYC.

faqs.question: 9. Can I earn Marriott points on a hotel package booked through Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection?
faqs.answer: Yes. Qualifying Marriott Bonvoy participating hotel packages booked through RCYC earn five points per dollar on the qualifying hotel package rate.

faqs.question: 10. Can I redeem Marriott points for the hotel portion of an RCYC package?
faqs.answer: No. Points cannot be redeemed for the RCYC hotel package rate. Marriott directs members to book eligible hotel awards separately through Marriott.com or the Marriott Bonvoy app.

faqs.question: 11. Can I earn points if I book through a travel advisor?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can earn Marriott Bonvoy points when booking through a travel professional, provided the applicable eligibility requirements are met.

faqs.question: 12. Can I add my Marriott Bonvoy number after booking?
faqs.answer: Yes. The official FAQ states that members can add their Marriott Bonvoy number after booking, but it should be provided at least 30 days before sailing to remain eligible.

faqs.question: 13. Can I redeem points after I have already booked the cruise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Points can be applied toward eligible cruise fare up to 121 days before the scheduled departure date, subject to the applicable terms.

faqs.question: 14. Can I redeem Marriott points online?
faqs.answer: Not through the standard RCYC online reservation flow. A Personal Travel Professional can assist with applying points to the voyage fare.

faqs.question: 15. Can I use Marriott points for another passenger?
faqs.answer: Yes. Points can be redeemed toward another guest's cruise fare when traveling on the same voyage. Different transfer requirements apply if the member is not traveling.

faqs.question: 16. Can I earn points on more than one suite?
faqs.answer: Yes. A member can earn on up to three suites at double occupancy when the member pays for and stays in one of the suites, subject to the program terms.

faqs.question: 17. Do cruise taxes and port fees qualify for Marriott points?
faqs.answer: No. Taxes, fees and port expenses are among the listed nonqualifying charges.

faqs.question: 18. Do Marriott Bonvoy credit cards earn additional points on Ritz-Carlton Yachts?
faqs.answer: Eligible Marriott Bonvoy co-branded credit cards may provide additional points according to the card's terms.

faqs.question: 19. When do Marriott Bonvoy points post after a Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruise?
faqs.answer: Eligible points and Elite Night Credits are generally posted within 14 days after completion of the voyage.

faqs.question: 20. Do Ritz-Carlton Yacht cruises count toward Marriott Bonvoy Ambassador status?
faqs.answer: The qualifying cash portion of Cruise Fare and eligible RCYC hotel package rates can count toward Marriott Bonvoy Ambassador Elite qualifying annual spend under the current terms.
